Frequently Asked Questions

What is the revenue of Patanjali Foods Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month revenue of Patanjali Foods Ltd. is ₹ 42,775.60 Cr, reflecting a 1-year growth of 19.21% and a 3-year CAGR of 10.07%. Annual and quarterly revenue trends are available in the Income Statement section.
What is the net profit of Patanjali Foods Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month net profit (PAT) of Patanjali Foods Ltd. is ₹ 1,969.85 Cr, with a 3-year earnings CAGR of 38.86%. Detailed profit history across annual and quarterly periods is in the Income Statement section.
What is the EBITDA of Patanjali Foods Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month EBITDA of Patanjali Foods Ltd. is approximately ₹ 1,735.22 Cr (based on an operating margin of 4.06%). EBITDA reflects core operating profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation.
What is the EPS of Patanjali Foods Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month Earnings Per Share (EPS) of Patanjali Foods Ltd. is 18.11. EPS trends across annual and quarterly periods are visible in the Income Statement section.
What is the debt level of Patanjali Foods Ltd.?
The debt-to-equity ratio of Patanjali Foods Ltd. stands at 0.21. The interest coverage ratio is 11.75x, reflecting the company's ability to service debt from operating earnings. The full breakdown of total borrowings is in the Balance Sheet section.
What is the book value per share of Patanjali Foods Ltd.?
The estimated book value per share of Patanjali Foods Ltd. is 120.36 (derived from a P/B ratio of 3.15 and market price of ₹ 379.00), reflecting the net asset value attributable to each share. See the Balance Sheet section for a full breakdown.
What is the cash flow from operations of Patanjali Foods Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month operating cash flow of Patanjali Foods Ltd. is ₹ -421.99 Cr. Annual and quarterly cash flow data is available in the Cash Flow section of the Statements tab.
Does Patanjali Foods Ltd. report consolidated or standalone financials?
Patanjali Foods Ltd. reports consolidated financials. You can toggle between consolidated and standalone views using the switch at the top of each statement section.
